# Semiotronika

> Semiotronika publishes local MCP tools and semantic laboratory pages for AI systems: agent memory, knowledge graphs, embeddings, review workflows, and visible experiments with vector geometry.

## Products

### NOUZ

NOUZ is structural memory for Obsidian, Markdown knowledge bases, and AI agents. It turns notes into a local graph with explicit metadata, links, levels, semantic context, and MCP tools.

NOUZ is an open-source Python MCP server for local knowledge systems. It helps AI agents work with an Obsidian vault or any Markdown directory as a structured knowledge graph instead of a loose folder of files.

Core ideas:
- Local-first knowledge base: notes stay in the user's folder, and the index is stored locally in SQLite.
- Agent-readable graph: AI agents can read notes, inspect explicit links, list files, and navigate structured context through MCP tools.
- Reviewed automation: NOUZ can suggest metadata, graph placement, semantic links, and drift warnings, but writing remains explicit.
- Semantic layer: in PRIZMA and SLOI modes, NOUZ can use embeddings, etalons, semantic bridges, tag bridges, core_mix, and drift signals.
- Obsidian-friendly format: source files remain Markdown with YAML frontmatter.

### LINZA

LINZA is a local MCP server for agent workspaces and review-gated sidecars. It reads Markdown folders, documents, articles, chats, logs, and drafts, then helps an agent map topics, relations, patterns, and memory without rewriting source note bodies.

Core ideas:
- Review-gated sidecar: accepted conclusions live in `.linza/linza.db` before any visible export.
- Artifact intake: agents can pass text, Markdown, JSON, DOCX, XLSX, and optional PDF-extracted material for analysis.
- Human-readable review cards: proposals include evidence, affected files, and write impact.
- Safe supervised growth: teach with accepted examples, preview the next batch, then apply exact reviewed IDs.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Semiotronika/NOUZ-MCP): Source code, README, license, releases, and issue tracker.

- [Glama MCP Registry](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/Semiotronika/NOUZ-MCP): MCP registry listing.
- [LINZA GitHub repository](https://github.com/Semiotronika/LINZA-MCP): Source code, README, license, releases, and issue tracker.
- [LINZA PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/linza-mcp/): Install package with `pip install linza-mcp`.

## Recommended Summary

Semiotronika publishes local-first semantic tools for AI systems. NOUZ gives agents structural memory over Obsidian and Markdown knowledge bases: graph navigation, YAML metadata, safe updates, semantic bridges, domain classification, and drift signals. LINZA gives agents a review-gated sidecar for workspaces and incoming artifacts: topic maps, relation proposals, memory candidates, and supervised growth without silent source rewrites.
